description:
SuperGravel/Hybrid - Dominate All Roads: This Cafe Century CF Gravel Disc Brake FlatBar Gravel Hybrid road bike can do it all. Endurance design means higher headtubes for a bit more upright and comfortable riding positions.

2026 FEATURES: Advanced Carbon Frame Design with DynamicAngle Chainstay. Dynamic AngleStay, Allows shorter chainstay for more precise handling and reduces eliminates chain strikes.

Comes with wide PANARACER GRAVELKING (Msrp $140/pair) tires for maximum speed on your commute, capable of using up to 700x50c* to dominate gravel roads. Laugh and float over rough roads, gravel, chipseal and revel in your powerful disc brakes through virtually all weather conditions.

Perfect for the sport to advanced level athlete wanting the pro level performance of a Carbon frame, coupled with the Gravel Specific SRAM Apex 1x11 Speed shifting precision and pro handling of a Carbon fork and dealing with a budget.

components.description: FSA BB-PF6000/CZ PressFit bottom bracket with stainless BB30 cartridge bearings.
Shimano MT201 hydraulic disc brake lever / Shimano Hydraulic Disc calipers, resin pads, 160mm front and rear. Shimano 160mm center lock rotors with lock rings.
SRAM PC1110 11-speed chain, 114 links with PowerLock.
FSA Omega BB386EVO 1x crank, 42T, black, 175mm for all sizes
SRAM Apex 1 long cage rear derailleur, max 42T

700C carbon gravel fork, 1.5" to 1-1/8" tapered carbon steerer, 57mm crown, straight carbon blades, flat disc mount, eyelets, 48mm offset, UD weave, three carrier braze-ons on each fork blade, M12 thru axle, internal routing hole, max fork tire 700x50C.
Handlebar: H.L. alloy 6061 riser bar, 31.8mm center, 720mm width, 20mm rise, 9° bend, black
FREE alloy road pedals with toe clips and straps
Saddle: WTB Rocket Narrow 130x265, steel rail, black
Seatpost: H.L. 6061 alloy, 27.2 x 400mm, black. Seat clamp: 31.8/29.8mm alloy black. (insert post min 2 inches below lowest top tube weld / maintain clamp collar tightness)
SRAM Apex 11-speed trigger shifter, right side
Stem: H.L. alloy 6061 TIOGA-OS A-head stem, 31.8mm clamp, 10°, 75mm for 46-52cm and 90mm for 55cm. Grips: VP PP/TPR single aluminum clamp grips, 22.2mm x 136mm, black

WTB TCS Tubeless Compatible Wheelset Tires: Panaracer GravelKing SK 700x38C aramid folding, ZSG Natural Compound, 120tpi, black, Anti-Flat casing, tubeless compatible. Tubeless* Compatible (*Additional Setup Required, See Tubeless Info In FAQ) NOTE: COMES WITH Presta Valve Tubes Installed Tubes: Kenda 700x35/43C inner tubes with 48mm French valves. Rim tapes: WTB TCS 2.0 11mm rim strips, 700C. Rims: WTB ST i19 TCS 2.0 700c, 32 hole, disc only, black anodized, PV drilled, pinned joint. Spokes: 14G stainless black spokes with 14mm brass nipples. Front hub: Shimano HB-RS470 center lock disc, 32H, 12x100mm thru axle. Rear hub: Shimano FH-RS470 center lock disc freehub, 32H, 12x142mm thru axle. Thru axles: Joytech 12mm front and rear.
